title: Night Cream for Rough Skin Texture: A Simple Plan for Smoother Skin
ex: What causes rough facial texture, which ingredients help skin look smoother, and a simple weekly night plan that avoids harsh scrubbing.
rt: Night Cream for Rough Skin Texture: Simple Plan | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for rough skin texture: common causes, ingredients for smoother-looking skin, a weekly night plan by skin type and habits that make texture worse.
keyword: night cream for rough skin texture
quick: Most rough texture comes from dryness and dead skin build-up. Use a moisturising night cream with a smoothing ingredient such as niacinamide most nights, add gentle exfoliation once or twice a week, avoid harsh scrubs and wear sunscreen daily. Skin feels softer within days and looks smoother over 8–12 weeks.
facts: Dryness and dead skin build-up cause most rough texture
Exfoliate only once or twice a week
Niacinamide and hyaluronic acid support a smoother look
A cream cannot change deep acne scars
